Become a CMU Student
Freshman and transfer students
You've graduated, or will soon graduate, from high school or an equivalent program. If you have completed some college-level courses while in high school, like dual enrollment, Early Middle College or AP credits, you are still considered a freshman student.
International students
You are not currently a U.S. citizen or permanent resident and are looking to take classes in the United States on a temporary F-1 student visa.
Graduate students
You have completed, or will soon complete, a bachelor's degree and are enrolling to pursue a master's, specialist or doctorate degree. Includes information for military and veteran students too.
Online students
You are looking to earn a degree by attending classes online or at satellite locations, not on campus, through CMU Online.
Medical students
You are interested in earning an M.D. from Central Michigan University.
Military and veteran students
You have a military background and are looking to earn a degree online or at Fort Leavenworth from Central Michigan University.
Charter School educators and students
You are an educators who teaches at or a student who attends a Charter School.
